about: Light propeller planes: the engine and propeller by power, starting with a cough and stopping, a pass overhead, landing gear, touchdown, the stall horn and the cockpit.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest.

prompts.text: A small single-engine propeller plane idles on the ground: the piston engine putters and the propeller hums steadily, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/low.want: the propeller engine at low revs

prompts.text: A small propeller plane taxis at low power: a steady droning buzz of the propeller and engine, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/mid.want: the propeller engine at middle revs

prompts.text: A small propeller plane runs at cruise power: a loud steady droning propeller roar, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/high.want: the propeller engine at full power

prompts.text: A small propeller plane at full throttle for take-off: a loud straining propeller roar and engine snarl, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/start.want: the starter, a cough and the engine catching

prompts.text: A small propeller plane's engine is started: the starter whirs, the propeller turns over, the engine coughs, sputters and catches into a rough idle, one start. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/stop.want: the engine cut and the propeller winding down

prompts.text: A small propeller plane's engine is shut off: the engine cuts with a last cough and the propeller winds down and stops, one shutdown. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

A small propeller plane flies low overhead and away: the engine drone grows loud, passes with a Doppler sweep and fades into the distance, one pass. Recorded outdoors from the ground, no music, no voices, quiet background.

gear.want: the landing gear lowering and locking

prompts.text: An airplane's landing gear lowers with a hydraulic whine and locks with a heavy clunk, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
An airplane's wheels touch down on a runway: a short tyre screech and a heavy thump, four separate touchdowns with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
One small airplane landing: its tyres chirp and squeal briefly on the runway with a thump, then silence. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A light airplane's stall warning horn blares a harsh buzzing tone, three separate warnings with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

Inside the cockpit of a small propeller plane in flight: a loud steady engine drone and propeller buzz through the cabin with wind noise, constant. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
